news.headline: Crude slips ~0.5-0.7% (WTI $88.1, Brent $95.2)
news.what_happened: WTI -0.5% and Brent -0.7% in latest session, extending easing from ~$107 a month ago.
news.why_it_matters: Lower crude trims jet fuel and petro-derived raw material costs for airlines and paints.

news.headline: Wall Street ends lower; Nasdaq -0.9%, S&P -0.4%, US 10Y at 5.15%
news.what_happened: US equities fell as the 10-year yield rose to ~5.15%; Nikkei -1.5%, Hang Seng +0.9%.
news.why_it_matters: Risk-off tilt and a falling Nasdaq are a headwind for Indian IT and a cautious cue for the open.

news.headline: Nifty ends Friday at 25,144 (-0.6%), snapping 3-day gains
news.what_happened: Sensex fell ~0.4% to 81,592 on higher crude and elevated retail inflation; FII reportedly bought ~Rs 5,737 Cr (single source, provisional).
news.why_it_matters: FII buying is supportive but global cues are soft; expect a cautious start.

picks.logic: Jet fuel is a major share of IndiGo's operating cost, so lower crude directly helps margins. Stock fell 1.3% Friday, leaving room for a modest bounce.
Crude derivatives are a large share of paint raw material cost; easing crude supports margin outlook.
